description: Source code for a ZIP extraction utility using yauzl, implementing an Extractor class with methods to extract ZIP entries, handle symlinks, directories, and manage extraction modes. Exports an async function to initialize extraction with given path and options.

classes.name: Extractor
classes.description: A class that handles extracting ZIP files, processing entries, creating directories, handling symlinks, and managing extraction modes.

methods.name: extract
methods.description: Opens the ZIP file, reads entries, and processes each entry for extraction.

methods.name: extractEntry
methods.description: Extracts a single ZIP entry, creating directories, handling symlinks, and writing files.

methods.name: getExtractedMode
methods.description: Determines the file mode for extracted entries based on ZIP entry attributes and options.
